name: CoC — Qualifying Period — AC1: Retain Earnings (14–167 day course, withdrawn ≥ 14 days in)
description: Creates an apprenticeship with a 99-day planned duration (14–167 day band, qualifying period = 14 days), approves it, then records a withdrawal after 15 days in learning. Because 15 >= 14, earnings for periods prior to the withdrawal date should be retained. Covers FLP-1424 AC1.

steps.name: SLD Records Withdrawal (15 days in learning — at or above 14-day qualifying period)
